python3 -c "
import pathlib,re
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('system-spec').rglob('*.md')):
  t=p.read_text()
  hs=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('#')]
  print('=====',p,len(t)); print('\n'.join(hs))
"
